q: 经理说会议定在___。

en: I have a video conference at half past two, so I can't go for lunch.

en: It's ten to eleven and Manager Li isn't in yet, so the meeting may be delayed.

It's five to nine now.

手术九点零五分开始，大概要两个小时。

en: The company's profit this year is one million yuan, a good deal more than last year.

en: This city has twenty million people, and there is always traffic on the way to work.
